Class JdbcSessionRecordRepository

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.jdbc.JdbcSessionRecordRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class JdbcSessionRecordRepository extends Object implements SessionRecordRepository
JDBC implementation of SessionRecordRepository backed by the who_session table.
